Use-case / requirements (concise):

- Secondary: chat-based support assistant for end-users (latency tolerance up to 700ms for desktop UI).
- Throughput: steady ~250 reqs/min with 5x spikes during nightly batch jobs.
- Cost sensitivity: mid-market constraints; interested in reserved capacity discounts + autoscale burst.
- Model preferences: open Llama-variant or curated open models; need transparent perf profiles.
- Routing/fallback: want Hosted for dev and staged workloads; Dedicated for production; automatic fallback to smaller quantized variants acceptable.

Security / compliance specifics:
- Must present SOC2 Type II report and SOC control summary (security team to validate).
- SAML SSO + provisioning required (Okta).
- Audit logs: need token-level and route-level logs retained for 13 months; ability to export logs to customer SIEM.
- Retention controls: configurable data retention per dataset and ability to purge on-demand (legal requirement).
- KMS: bring-your-own-key (AWS KMS) for model payload encryption at rest.
- Network: VPC peering + private endpoints preferred; no direct internet egress for inference nodes.
